Level 20 Age-Composition Residual Diagnostics
=============================================

Interpretation
--------------
Residuals are observed minus predicted age-composition proportions.
This report now uses the same objective-consistent prediction path as
the Level 20 model: fitted initial numbers, fitted longline selectivity,
fitted age-specific purse-seine selectivity, and the same annual state
update used in the objective.
